records.name: FDA expanded-access information
records.who: Patients, carers and clinicians seeking US expanded-access information
records.what: Free public information about requesting an investigational product through a licensed physician. Treatment is not guaranteed or necessarily free: product supply, clinical care and institutional review can involve separate charges. For investigational drugs, FDA permission to charge is separate from authorisation to treat. Discuss costs and insurance cover with the supplier and care team.
